name: Trukk
_source_note: Stats, weapons, keywords, composition and points match this datasheet on Wahapedia's 11th edition Orks page, read 2026-10-13. Ability text in data/abilities.json is a summary.
_costing_note: Printed as: 1st to 3rd unit 60 pts for 1 model; 4th+ unit 70 pts for 1 model.
_composition_note: Printed as: 1 Trukk model. Keyed by unit size, then by model; the model mix on the card, and how many of each weapon the unit starts with, follow from it.
_transport_note: Printed as: This model has a transport capacity of 12 ORKS INFANTRY models. It cannot transport GHAZGHKULL THRAKA/JUMP PACK models. Each MEGA ARMOUR model takes up the space of 2 models.
transportCapacity: 12 ORKS INFANTRY models. Each MEGA ARMOUR model counts as 2. It cannot carry GHAZGHKULL THRAKA or JUMP PACK models.
_loadout: This model is equipped with: 1 Dual Big Shoota; 1 Spiked Ram.
_weapons_note: carriedBy names the model(s) that start with a weapon — { model: n } when one carries several — so its count follows the unit's size. A weapon with no carriedBy is only ever taken through a wargear option.
